summary_en: Dreambed executed a block acquisition of 70,000 shares at 814 yen per share through ToSTNeT-3 on November 13, 2026, totaling 57 million yen and representing 1.71% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, Dreambed's board of directors authorized the execution of a block acquisition of treasury stock. The company purchased 70,000 shares at 814 yen per share through an off-hours trading facility (ToSTNeT-3) on November 13, 2026. The total acquisition cost was 57 million yen, representing 1.71% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock. The fixed purchase price of 814 yen was the closing price (including final special quotation) as of the disclosure date.

The acquisition was undertaken to enhance shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and strengthen the company's capital allocation flexibility in response to changing business conditions, with the ultimate aim of enhancing enterprise value. Results were scheduled to be announced immediately following the completion of the ToSTNeT-3 trading session on the morning of November 13, 2026.
